💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Drum-Belly: Strike the taut drum. When the belly swells drum-taut, STRIKE — the stretched skin is thin as a drumhead and the thunderclap backfires, stunning it senseless. Hit the drum, not the drummer. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hummice: Bellow at the choir. The Swarm Hum stacks while you stand in it — but the hum needs the choir. SHOUT and the bellow scatters it. Raw noise, no words, all lungs. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hushpuppy: Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Anaconda Empress: Strike the head as it coils. When the coils start to wrap, don't pull away — strike the head and eyes. It will release to protect them. On land it is slow and heavy; it needs the water to be the Empress. Never let it get a second wrap. (You did the thing —

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Living Wire: Get OUT of the water. When the crackling starts, step onto dry ground — the discharge cannot reach you there. On land it is just a long blind fish: slow, harmless, dinner. Never fight it standing in the creek. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Rut King: Give it a tree. His antler rack catches on trunks — keep a tree between you and let the charge tangle. Step aside at the last breath and strike while he is pulling free. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
📖 The memory leaves something behind: Jewelweed — the orange touch-me-not by creeks. Poison ivy’s antidote. The book taught you.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Flashbulb Moth: Hit it while it folds. The Wing Flash only fires FORWARD — it must face you. Circle while it folds its wings and hit it before the wings open. It can't flash what's behind it. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Ugly-Eyes: Be three tiles out. The bloom is the timer: two beats of brightening, then white. Be three tiles out when it flares. The ember beat after is safe — walk in and finish it while it glows itself out. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Understudy: Hit it with something it's never seen. It copies what it sees — strike with a weapon it has NEVER seen and the copy falls apart. The familiar is what kills you. Switch weapons mid-fight and it's back to guessing. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Paparazzo: Break line of sight before the fourth shot. Four shots is the whole fight — break line of sight before the fourth and the model starves. The EXCLUSIVE cannot be dodged, only prevented: move while the lens steadies. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Sunback: Fight from its shadow side. When it arches, move to its SHADOW side — between it and the sun — and don't stand still. The lunge goes where you WERE, and the glare can't touch you from the shade. Strike while it's recharging the scales. (Someone at the haven knew the tri

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Redactor: Go quiet — starve the redaction. It redacts the loudest thing first, and the handles point a full round before the redaction lands. Go quiet for two turns and its attacks come thin; a third quiet turn starves it out of the fight. (Striking feeds it — every wound ge

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — ducks in a row: Break the line. The line is one animal, but only while it's whole. Strike a duck that ISN'T the head and the line splits — both halves hunt on their own and the formation dies. Break the line, then thin the pieces. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

🧾 The abacus beads CLICK — AUDIT DAY. The clipboard flips to YOUR sheet: "strike" flagged INEFFICIENT. Taxed: half strength for 2 rounds. (Deliberate jank between audits keeps the good stuff off the sheet.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Nightlight: Never wade in. The glow is a mouth — it waits for you to come close. Never wade in. Strike the light from two squares out and it's just a fish with a lamp. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — mosquito: Hit it after it drinks. It only drinks adjacent — keep your distance during the dive. After it drinks it's HEAVY and SLOW: that's when you hit it. Smoke and fire ruin its whole plan. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Static: Don't walk toward the voice. Resist the lure: don't move toward the crying. Two rounds of refusal and the act breaks — it's a radio, exposed and furious, and it has to re-spool before it rushes. That's your window. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Chorus Line: Dance on the downbeat. The kick only lands on beat 4 of the 4/4 count. Dance and it catches air — but dancing is your whole turn. (Yuki lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Heckler: WAIT to answer back. SHAME is the damage, not the swing — WAIT to answer back and clear it before the HEADLINER pile-on. The words demand a response. Give them one, on your terms. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Speedbump: Never stand next to it. Don't step next to it — it can't chase, so just walk around. Keep two squares away and it's furniture. When it seals up, wait it out. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
★ IDENTIFIED: Datura. The trumpet-flower bush — every part is a delirium poison. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Nevermore: Step OFF the strafing lane. The shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides — a straight black lane. Step OFF it, not along it: it can't turn mid-run. It always lands after a run, hit or miss. Punish the landing. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
